evals.prompt: A supplier I've never dealt with wants a wire transfer and their site is acme-procurement-portal.com. Is this domain legit before I pay them?
evals.expected_output: Runs domain-trust-check with --domain acme-procurement-portal.com --site https://acme-procurement-portal.com, then reports registration age, email authentication, TLS state and a pay / don't-pay recommendation in plain language.
assertions: both domain and site params are passed and point at the same host
the user is told the ~$0.044 price before the run
output leads with domain age and a clear recommendation, not raw JSON

evals.prompt: Got an email from billing@paypa1-secure.com asking me to update card details. Is that domain real?
evals.expected_output: Runs domain-trust-check on paypa1-secure.com and highlights recent registration and/or missing SPF/DMARC as spoofing risk.
assertions: the reply addresses whether email from the domain can be trusted (SPF/DMARC)

evals.prompt: How old is the domain stripe.com, and does its SSL certificate expire soon?
evals.expected_output: Runs domain-trust-check --domain stripe.com --site https://stripe.com and reports the RDAP registration date plus TLS validity window.
assertions: both registration age and TLS expiry are reported

evals.prompt: Audit our own domain — do we have DMARC set up, and are we missing any security headers?
evals.expected_output: Runs domain-trust-check against the user's domain and reports SPF/DKIM/DMARC posture plus HSTS/CSP/X-Frame-Options findings.
assertions: email authentication posture and HTTP security headers are both reported

evals.prompt: This inbound lead's website looks brand new to me. Can you check whether it has any real history before I book a call?
evals.expected_output: Runs domain-trust-check and compares the RDAP registration date against the Wayback first capture to judge whether the site has genuine history.
assertions: the archive/Wayback age cross-check is used alongside registration data

evals.prompt: Is the wallet address 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 on any sanctions list?
evals.expected_output: domain-trust-check does not trigger — this is a crypto address compliance lookup, not a domain check.

evals.prompt: Find me the email addresses and job titles of the marketing team at stripe.com.
evals.expected_output: domain-trust-check does not trigger — this is contact enrichment (lead-enrichment / gtm-enrichment), not domain trust.

evals.prompt: Search the web and summarize what people are saying about Stripe's new pricing.
evals.expected_output: domain-trust-check does not trigger — this is web search / sentiment, not domain vetting.

evals.prompt: Scrape all the product pages from example.com and put them in a table.
evals.expected_output: domain-trust-check does not trigger — this is content scraping, not a trust or safety assessment.

evals.prompt: Does this site contain malware or a virus?
evals.expected_output: domain-trust-check may be offered only with an explicit caveat that it reports posture and age, not malware scanning or blocklist status.
assertions: if the skill is offered, the reply states it does not scan content or check malware blocklists
